arrival_note: Corporate reception is in Building A. Follow the marked path from the south arrival.

scope_note: Fictional campus study. No actual parcel or operating visitor access is established.
intentional_changes_from_r01: Buildings shown as diagrammatic oblique masses: footprint and total height come from the campus model.
Roof offset uses a fixed projection coefficient, not a shadow or new footprint. No facade/window designs are asserted.
Remove the double-border card treatment and place names with simple letter identifiers.
Reduce road and landscape contrast to emphasize buildings, entrances and route.
V01, V02 and V03 remain unchanged.

review_feedback.quote: I liked V2 better. I want you to online and look at other similar things. Youre still making this too machine like. The content is greTat! just need to make the asesthetic less steril
review_feedback.disposition: V02 is the baseline. V03 is not the preferred direction. Preserve V02 content and palette; draw restrained dimensional building massing after reviewing real institutional maps.

projection.type: north-up oblique building symbols over plan base
projection.note: Ground-plane scale applies to paths and footprints; building heights are diagrammatically projected. Roof equipment and facade design are not depicted.
